instruction: I'm watching a lecture PDF with background music playing in VLC. The video player window displays a traffic cone icon when no video is playing, which I find distracting. Could you help me disable this background cone icon so the interface looks cleaner while I study?

parameters.window_name: lecture.pdf — 6.006 Introduction to Algorithms, Lecture 2: Data Structures

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires user to disable VLC's background cone icon (qt-bgcone=0). The evaluator uses existing check_qt_bgcone metric to verify that qt-bgcone setting is set to 0 in VLC config file.
metadata.verification: Verified using existing check_qt_bgcone function. Expected value: qt-bgcone=0 (disabled). Default is 1 (enabled).

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly extracts VLC config file (vlcrc) using get_vlc_config getter
Metric check_qt_bgcone properly parses config file and checks qt-bgcone setting value
Expected value (qt-bgcone=0) is semantically correct for disabling the background cone icon
Metric correctly handles default value (1=enabled) when setting is not found in config
Postconfig appropriately kills and relaunches VLC to ensure settings are persisted to config file
Complete coverage: evaluator checks exactly what instruction requires (disable background cone icon)
Data flow is correct: instruction -> user sets qt-bgcone=0 -> getter extracts config -> metric verifies value
Edge cases properly handled: missing setting, file not found, type conversion (int/string)
